app.title: Photothèque
settings.title: Settings
settings.tiltHelp: Picasa's unit is undocumented. Calibration compares originals in .picasaoriginals with the photos Picasa saved.
settings.calibrateNone: No usable photo: originals in .picasaoriginals folders are required.
prompt.deleteAlbum: Album “{name}” ({n} photo(s)) will be deleted. The photos themselves are neither erased nor removed from the library: only this grouping goes away.
viewer.caption: Caption
viewer.perspectiveNoExif: No focal length in EXIF: default value used.
viewer.saved: Edits saved (the photo itself is unchanged)
faces.none: No face groups yet. Enable face detection in the settings.
faces.name: Name
faces.hint: Using the name of an existing person merges the two.
settings.rotateHelp: Unchecked by default: a counter-clockwise quarter turn, as in Picasa. Rescans automatically.
settings.autoTagsHelp: Comma-separated list, e.g. architecture, facade, church. A correction removed by hand is not reapplied.
settings.aiClip: Automatic tags, natural-language search, similar photos (CLIP, ≈ 155 MB)
settings.aiLicense: InsightFace models are for non-commercial use only.
faces.deleteConfirm: The faces of “{name}” will no longer be grouped. If they have a name, it is removed from the photos. Photos are not deleted.
viewer.autoenhanceHelp: White balance, exposure, local contrast, vibrance
viewer.compareHelp: Hold the button (or the O key) to see the original
prompt.deleteAlbumPicasa: This album comes from Picasa: it will not come back on later scans (the .picasa.ini file is not modified).
folder.excludeTitle: Remove a folder from the library
folder.excludeConfirm: “{name}” ({n} photo(s)) will no longer be shown or indexed. The folder and its photos stay untouched on disk. You can bring it back from the Settings.
folder.excludeRoot: This is a library root: it will be removed from the folder list (nothing is deleted on disk).
settings.watch: Automatically detect added or deleted photos
settings.watchHelp: On a network share (NAS), detection is not always possible: use the Rescan button.
viewer.autoenhanceToggle: Click again to undo the enhancement
viewer.zoomHint: Click and hold: zoom (drag to move, single click to return). Double-click: full screen.
settings.cacheHelp: Beyond that, the least recently viewed previews are deleted first (they are recomputed on demand). Checked every 15 minutes.
viewer.videoError: Cannot play this video (see the log).
plantnet.title: Plant identification (Pl@ntNet)
plantnet.help: Photos with one of the tags below and no caption are sent to Pl@ntNet; the plant name becomes their caption (saved in the directives, the photo is not modified). The quota is counted per UTC day and resets at 00:00 UTC.
plantnet.msg.quota: Daily quota reached: run again after the reset.
viewer.picasaKind.caption: caption
viewer.goFolder: Show this folder in the library
wp.title: WordPress publishing
wp.help: Publishes an album's photos in a post on your blog through the WordPress REST API. Create an application password in WordPress (Users › Profile › Application Passwords): your regular password is never used.
wp.testRights: Connected as {name}, but this account cannot upload media or publish posts.
wp.privacy: Images are sent with their edits and without EXIF data (no GPS position, no camera).
wp.willUpdate: Album already published: the post will be updated.
wp.notConfigured: Set up the blog in the settings first.
wp.err.auth: WordPress rejected the username or application password.
wp.err.config: Blog address, username or application password missing.
wp.err.network: Blog unreachable (address, connection or certificate; see the log).
wp.err.not_json: The blog does not answer like a WordPress API (REST API disabled or blocked by a security plugin?).
wp.err.not_found: WordPress REST API not found at this address.
wp.err.empty: No photos to publish in this album.
wp.check.home_http: The blog declares its address as {home} (http, no s) while you reach it over https. Change “WordPress Address” and “Site Address” to https in Settings › General.
wp.check.app_passwords_unavailable: WordPress does not offer application passwords: it does not detect HTTPS (often due to the http address), or a security plugin disables them.
wp.check.no_credentials_received: WordPress received no credentials: the host strips the “Authorization” header (common on OVH). Install the phototheque-auth.php plugin (Photothèque's “wordpress” folder) into the blog's wp-content/mu-plugins/.
wp.check.wrong_password: Password rejected: use an application password (not the account password).
wp.check.wrong_user: Unknown username: use your WordPress login, not the display name.
wp.check.app_passwords_disabled: Application passwords are disabled on this blog or for this account (security plugin?).
wp.check.plugin_missing: WordPress received no credentials and the phototheque-auth.php plugin does not answer: install it (or its version 1.1) into wp-content/mu-plugins/.
wp.check.headers_stripped: The plugin is there, but the server passes neither the Authorization header nor the fallback header to PHP. A firewall or proxy in front of the site filters headers: check with the host. Details: {detail}
wp.check.diag: Credentials do reach WordPress but are not accepted. Details from the plugin: {detail}
settings.enhanceApplyConfirm: The enhancement strength will change from {from} to {to} for the {n} enhanced photo(s), including those from Picasa filters. The photos themselves are not modified: only the directives change, and thumbnails will be recomputed.
settings.enhanceNone: No enhanced photos: the new strength will be used from now on.
viewer.cropHint: Drag the handles or move the box; Enter to apply, Esc to cancel.
